ticket: T-0744 (piece 3 of the split of T-0657); the ask is T-0528 and before it T-0495
read_pass: read_census_continuation.py ACCEPTS this leaf - unlike 33S7-9YYJ-FJ, whose rules it refused - and named the eight middle columns off the leaf's own printed rules at a 68 px pitch. So the column geometry here is measured by the module rather than located by hand, and every window below is the module's. The seven industry columns were READ FIRST, because their five printed footings are the only arithmetic on the leaf that can be closed independently of the TOTAL column: all five close exactly and the glyph key is taken off those closures. The TOTAL column was then read against that key off shear-corrected crops - this hand leans about 39 degrees off upright and a shear of 0.80 in x per unit y stands it up without the rotation a per-glyph montage applies. 21 of the 27 enumerated lines carry a figure this pass commits; 6 do not. Five of the six two-stroke figures are settled with T-0652's established discriminator rather than by eye (total_matched_pair).
lines_note: 27, and it is measured rather than counted by eye. The TOTAL column's ink resolves into 27 row positions carrying a figure or a fragment of one, plus two marks refused as ink that is not an entry (a 12 x 14 mark at y 1607 and a 9 x 19 mark at y 1758, both below the 23 x 29 smallest standing figure this leaf writes and both on the FJ precedent that a line enumerating nobody is not a line). The count is CORROBORATED and not merely asserted: the five written industry columns hold 16 entries on 13 distinct rows, and every one of those 13 rows is also a row of the TOTAL column - no industry entry stands on a line the TOTAL column does not carry. Both prior figures are superseded. coverage.json carried 31 'to the nearest line' from the contact-sheet pass. pairing_key_26_50.json carried 29, measured with census_total_column.py over x 0.300-0.360 of the image width; on this 3912 px leaf that window is x 1173-1408, which stops 9 px inside the TOTAL cell's left rule at 1164 and runs 50 px past its right rule at 1358 into the MINING column. The window this pass reads, x 1164-1358, is the module's own reading of the printed rules.

line_index.committed: measured row positions in px, NOT a fitted line number. Each record carries total_ink_cy, the y centre of its ink.
line_index.why_no_uniform_grid_here: a uniform grid is REFUSED on this leaf, as it was on 33S7-9YYJ-K2 and unlike 33S7-9YYJ-FJ. Fitted over the 13 industry anchor rows alone the best grid is pitch 81.96 px at rms 9.29 with residuals running to 18.5 px; fitted over the 27 TOTAL rows it collapses onto the search's pitch floor and leaves 11 of 38 grid lines unoccupied, which is a grid describing nothing. The leaf's own row spacing is not constant: 74 px mean over lines 2-6 (79, 69, 82, 68), 72 px over lines 19-24 (71, 66, 86, 76, 71), and gaps of 140 and 156 px between lines 14/15 and 15/16 where no ink stands in any column. Rather than launder that into a line number, the row index IS the measured y and the reader can see the spacing.

form_note: The right (continuation) sheet of the 1840 population schedule. On this leaf the twelve SLAVES columns, the PENSIONERS block, the ten DEAF AND DUMB, BLIND, AND INSANE columns and the SCHOOLS columns carry no ink in the body and no figure at the foot, and this pass reads them as not written rather than as zeros. TOTAL is written throughout. Of the seven industry columns five are written - agriculture, commerce, manufactures and trades, navigation of canals lakes and rivers, and learned professions and engineers - and mining and navigation of the ocean are blank in the body and at the foot. The two components the ink mask finds in the navigation-of-the-ocean window (9 x 22 at y 1763 and 9 x 33 at y 2856) are the printed rule itself, not writing, and the blank footing agrees.

column_geometry.how: read_census_continuation.py, unaided: it found 43 vertical rules at a 68 px pitch and bracketed the industry run between TOTAL and PENSIONERS as the form requires. No window here is a human judgement.
column_geometry.why_it_matters: pairing_key_26_50.json measured this column over x 0.300-0.365 and y 0.175-0.918 of the image, which is 9 px inside the left rule and 50 px past the right one, and got 29 groups at dy 45 and 55. Over the rules themselves the same tool gets 30 groups, and those 30 components resolve into the 27 rows below.

glyph_key.what: the forms this reading leans on. Every one is taken off this leaf, and the four that carry the reading are held by arithmetic rather than by opinion: the five written industry columns close only on these values.
glyph_key.1: a plain slant, no bowl and no loop, 23 to 48 px wide - the form eleven of the sixteen industry entries carry.
glyph_key.0: a narrow closed loop, taller than wide. It stands alone in commerce at y 2429, in manufactures and trades at y 1633 and in navigation of canals at y 1634, and each of those three columns closes on its printed footing only if the loop is a nought.
glyph_key.2: a heavy blob at the top running down into a sweeping base. It stands in manufactures and trades at y 1440 and the column's printed footing of 7 closes only on 2 there.
glyph_key.5: a flat top stroke over a bowl open to the left, written either as two components or as one unbroken movement. It is the third glyph of the enumerator's own footing 115.
glyph_key.3: two bowls open to the left, the upper smaller than the lower, with no top stroke.
glyph_key.6: a rising stroke closing into a loop at its foot, with no top stroke - what separates it from the 5.
glyph_key.4: a matched pair: a long bold stroke with a shorter companion beside it. It is held apart from a two-digit 11 by the axis separation of the two strokes, not by eye - see total_matched_pair.
glyph_key.not_a_figure: on the FJ precedent, a mark smaller than the leaf's smallest standing figure is ink and not an entry. This leaf's smallest committed figure is 23 x 30; the two marks refused are 12 x 14 and 9 x 19.

method: read_census_continuation.py's ink mask, component filter and grouping rule over the module's own column windows; the digits read by a human off shear-corrected crops of the component boxes (x sheared by 0.80 per unit y about each crop's mid-row, which uprights this hand). No digit is read by a tool, and no crop or render of the deposit is committed.

method_calibration.what: this leaf calibrates itself. The five written industry columns were read before the TOTAL column and each summed against its own printed footing.
method_calibration.result: all five close exactly: agriculture 1 = 1; commerce 1 + 0 + 1 + 1 = 3; manufactures and trades 1 + 1 + 2 + 0 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 7; navigation of canals lakes and rivers 1 + 0 = 1; learned professions and engineers 1 + 1 = 2. Sixteen entries over five footings, with no figure adjusted to make a column come out, and five further components refused as rule ink or specks - three of which had to be refused for their columns to close at all.
method_calibration.what_it_holds_and_what_it_does_not: it holds the 1, the 0, the 2 and the refusal rule. It says nothing about the 3, the 5, the 6 or the two-stroke form, none of which appears in an industry column; those rest on the footing row and on the leaf's internal consistency, and are committed at medium except where the form is the enumerator's own footing glyph.

footer_as_read.total_glyphs_as_read: three glyphs: a plain slant; a second plain slant; then a bowl under a long flat top stroke that runs to the cell's right rule. Read at 10x.
footer_as_read.total_note: the same figure pairing_key_26_50.json read off this cell in T-0656, and this pass does not disturb it. It is the page population key.
footer_as_read.footer_note: the industry footings are read off the same 10x crop as the TOTAL footing. Mining and navigation of the ocean carry no footing figure and no body ink; they are recorded as not written.

total_matched_pair.the_form: six lines - 1, 9, 15, 16, 17 and 26 - carry a figure of two near-parallel strokes. It is either a 4 written as a matched pair or the two digits of an 11, and this leaf labels neither: no industry column here carries a 4 and none carries a two-digit number.
total_matched_pair.the_key_this_pass_uses: T-0652's, on 33S7-9YYJ-8D, itself taken from 33S7-9YYJ-24 - the one continuation sheet in the deposit whose TOTAL column CLOSES on its printed footing, so that arithmetic labels each of its glyphs. Nothing new is invented here; the established discriminator is applied to a leaf that had not been measured with it.
total_matched_pair.the_metric: the horizontal distance between the two strokes' AXES, taken row by row over the rows the two strokes share and averaged, over read_census_continuation.py's own ink mask and components. A bounding box widens with the length of a slanted stroke, so box edges and box centres both confound separation with length; the axis distance does not. T-0652 showed the left-edge metric fails on the labelled sheet and this one does not.

the_labelled_bands.sheet: 33S7-9YYJ-24, TOTAL column, closes at its printed 201 over 31 lines

putting_the_two_sheets_on_one_scale.how: the same construction T-0652 used: the ratio of the two hands' mean single-stroke figure height. On 24 it is 34.9 px. On this leaf the single-stroke figures that are LABELLED are the sixteen 1s the five closing industry columns and the committed TOTAL lines carry - eleven in the industry columns (heights 41, 40, 38, 51, 39, 38, 42, 39, 43, 36, 41) and five in the TOTAL column (30, 34, 41, 43, 48) - and their mean height is 40.25 px.
putting_the_two_sheets_on_one_scale.bands_in_this_leaf_s_units: a within-4 separation is 9.6 to 21.3 px; a gap between two digits is 33.2 px.

line 1.note: the two strokes touch at the reading's ink threshold and were split without the morphological close, as T-0652 did for 8D's line 26. The figure is stable across thresholds: 14.5, 14.6 and 14.9 px at ink-below-background 45, 60 and 75.

total_matched_pair.the_verdict: five of the six are committed 4 and one is not. Lines 1, 16 and 17 fall inside the within-4 band outright; lines 9 and 15 stand 1.9 and 2.3 px above its top and 10.0 and 9.6 px below a gap between two digits, which is the same margin T-0652 accepted for 8D's line 19. LINE 26 IS NOT COMMITTED: at 28.6 px it is 7.3 px above the band and 4.6 px below the digit gap - nearer the gap than the band - and it is the only one of the six this leaf does not settle. It is recorded unread rather than swept in with the rest.
total_matched_pair.and_the_arithmetic_agrees_independently: the 11 reading is refused by the footing as well as by the metric, and the refusal does not depend on the key. Read all six as 11 and the column carries 51 + 66 = 117 against a printed 115 before any of the five remaining unread lines is counted. Read line 1 as 4 and the other five as 11 and it carries 110, leaving 5 across 6 unread lines each of which must be at least 1. Neither is possible. Nothing was assigned to make the footing come out - the metric was applied first and the arithmetic checked afterwards.
total_matched_pair.what_would_move_it: if line 26 is one day settled as 4 the column reads 75 and the residual falls to 40 over five lines; as 11 it reads 82 and the residual is 33 over five. Neither closes the leaf, so the choice is not the residual's to make.

closure.residual_note: the 21 committed lines sum to 71 against a printed footing of 115, leaving 44 for the 6 unread. That is a mean of 7.3 a line where the committed lines average 3.4, and the six are exactly where a leaf would put its large numbers: line 11 is a two-figure number this pass would not settle, line 14 is the boldest and tallest ink in the column at 45 x 72 px and was not divided, line 6 is a 47 x 50 component whose strokes run together, lines 7 and 19 are fragments standing without the rest of their figure, and line 26 is the matched pair the discriminator leaves between its two bands. Nothing is moved to make the footing come out and the residual is left standing.
closure.industry_closure: all five written industry columns close exactly on the enumerator's own printed footings - 1, 3, 7, 1 and 2 - over sixteen entries.

pairing_test.pair_under_test: 33S7-9YYJ-PC, printed page 218 - the nearest candidate in the deposit and the only one T-0656 recorded a refusal against for this leaf.
pairing_test.what_this_pass_changes: the refusal is now held by TWO keys instead of one. The population key is unchanged at 115 and PC foots 113 by all 38 of its columns and 113 by its own cells, so it is 2 short and its key is not soft. The line-count key was 'not counted this pass' in T-0656 and is now 27 against PC's 30 - three lines apart, and no relaxation of T-0642's exact-match rule reaches it. Where FJ's reading moved one key toward its candidate, this one moves the second key away from PC.
pairing_test.other_candidates: no left sheet read anywhere in the deposit carries a page population of 115, and none of the ten candidates pairing_key_26_50.json considered carries 27 lines - they hold 30 or 31. The sheet stays UNPAIRED.
